text:
ryan_pm: quick sync — we need a proposal for per-route quotas + pricing-aligned fields for chat / embeddings / function-calls. customer asks + launch gates.
anya: +1, I've got a customer asking for per-route paid tiers (high-emb-rate for search).
sam: curious if we treat function-calls differently for token accounting? many calls have tiny inputs but big outputs.
kevin: proposal = 1) per-route `quota_units` with `unit_type` {tokens, embeddings-requests, calls} 2) token accounting mode (input_only | output_only | both) 3) soft vs hard limits (soft = warn + meter, hard = reject).
dara: strong 👍 on soft-first for beta. we should avoid surprising failures during onboarding.
ryan_pm: agree. also need pricing fields to map to billing: `rate_per_unit`, `metering_key` so metering service can consume.
kevin: sketch of route schema:```json
{
  "route": "/v1/chat",
  "unit_type": "tokens",
  "quota_window_days": 30,
  "quota_limit": 1000000,
  "token_accounting": "both",
  "rate_per_unit": "0.0000025",
  "soft_limit_action": "notify",
  "hard_limit_action": "throttle"
}
```
anya: looks good. add `priority_class` for enterprise lanes so we can route through reserved capacity.
sam: add field `per_request_max_tokens` and `count_function_calls_as` so customers can choose to bill calls as X tokens if they want predictable cost.
dara: launch gating: must have (a) telemetry for accounting parity against existing per-token billing, (b) billing table mapping, (c) e2e from API -> metering -> invoice, (d) docs + SDK examples.
ryan_pm: timeline? we want beta internal in 2 weeks, external beta 6w, GA 12w. does that sound realistic?
kevin: 2 weeks for internal beta only if we cut scope: no enterprise priority yet, just soft limits + billing hook.
aya: (typo) I mean anya: ok. agree.
anya: customer QA: need migration path from current flat per-token to per-route quotas. suggestion: graceful opt-in flag `quota_v2_enabled` per account.
sam: edgecases: streaming responses — token accounting must count streamed tokens as they emit. also function-call reroutes should attribute tokens to the originating route.
dara: add acceptance tests: simulate streaming with 5k tokens, verify invoice matches metering records within 0.5% for three sample workloads.
billing-bot: jira ticket created: PROD-4523 "Per-route quotas & pricing fields - api surface spec" assigned to @kevin due 1970012440.
ryan_pm: actions: kevin to draft API spec + open PR for openapi; sam to write token-accounting test harness; anya to draft migration guide and customer comms; dara to own e2e acceptance criteria.
kevin: will do. I'll post a proto PR with minimal schema by EOD.
anya: one more ask from sales — ability to set per-customer override with billing owner contact. put that in spec as optional `customer_overrides` + `contact_email`.
sam: noted. also flag for `count_embeddings_as` because some customers want per-embedding vs per-token hybrid billing.
dryan: quick note — we need product signoff before we wire billing. ryan_pm can you confirm?
ryan_pm: yes i'll sign off once kevin's spec + acceptance tests exist. aiming for internal beta signoff 1970012420.
kevin: sending first draft now.
anya: thanks team :thumbsup:
